title: Reliance Industries Q2 FY27 Preview: What to Expect from Earnings Today
description: Reliance Industries is set to announce its Q2 FY27 results today, October 30, 2026, with analysts anticipating a robust performance. The Oil-to-Chemicals (O2C.

faq.q: What are the key expectations for Reliance Industries' Q2 FY27 results?
faq.a: Analysts expect RIL to report a modest increase in consolidated revenue and net profit, driven primarily by strong performance in its Oil-to-Chemicals (O2C) business. Digital Services (Jio) is also projected for steady growth, while Reliance Retail might see a more subdued performance.

faq.q: Which business segment is expected to drive RIL's growth this quarter?
faq.a: The Oil-to-Chemicals (O2C) business is anticipated to be the strongest performer, benefiting from robust refining margins, favourable petrochemical operations, and a weaker rupee.

faq.q: How is Reliance Jio Platforms expected to perform?
faq.a: Jio Platforms is forecast to maintain healthy growth, supported by consistent subscriber additions and a gradual improvement in Average Revenue Per User (ARPU). Investors will look for updates on JioFiber expansion and potential tariff hikes.

faq.q: What challenges might Reliance Retail face in Q2 FY27?
faq.a: Reliance Retail is expected to experience relatively muted growth and potential margin pressure due to the shift in the festive season and increased operational costs associated with scaling up hyperlocal deliveries.

faq.q: What should investors look for in management's commentary?
faq.a: Investors should focus on management's outlook on refining and petrochemical margins, crude sourcing strategies, Jio's future growth drivers (including tariff hikes), strategies for boosting retail performance, and updates on the New Energy business and any fund-raising plans.

faq.q: Will the recent Jio Platforms IPO impact RIL's Q2 results?
faq.a: While the IPO itself occurred just before the results announcement, management commentary around Jio Platforms' financial outlook and strategic direction post-listing will be closely scrutinised by investors.

faq.q: What is the expected consolidated EBITDA for RIL in Q2 FY27?
faq.a: Consolidated EBITDA is projected to increase by around 9% sequentially to approximately ₹51,942 crore, with some brokerages estimating it as high as ₹53,700 crore.
